svg.title: Using a demonstration across three studies

cc:Work.dc:title: Using a demonstration across three studies
cc:Work.dc:description: Points show paired differences. Bars and labels show ±2 standard errors across 128 world families per lineage. Both panels use the same scale. Positive values favor the intact movie. Every assigned newborn counts. Studies use independent worlds. E123 adds an engineered calibrated readout to the original observer genomes. Cross-study differences are descriptive. Full experiment gates include additional controls reported in the README.
